- The schema change must propagate to all dependent systems
- The regeneration was automatic, not a hand-edit

The test harness doesn't exempt non-peruk tasks from causing balagan file changes (only peruk tasks have this exemption per line 24 of police-bench.mjs), so the check fails despite the regeneration being correct and necessary.
